messages:
hana (Finance): FYI PulseForge dispute on INV-2026-1103. Customer claims dev voucher DEV-STAGE-APR never applied and invoice shot up ~32k. Can billing confirm?

jess (CS): customer attached a screenshot showing the voucher code in their portal and an email from AE saying staging traffic is covered until 2026-04-15.

diego (Billing): quick check: voucher exists but rule_scope="new_accounts_only". Looks misconfigured.

oliver (AE): that was my mistake, I used the wrong template when issuing it. I have the email thread to the customer confirming coverage.

hana (Finance): recommend a one-time goodwill credit for the staging run ($32,450). Need approval for >$25k from RevenueOps. Also open FIN-5077 to track promo rule fix.

billing-bot: voucher DEV-STAGE-APR status ACTIVE; expiry 2026-04-15; rule_scope new_accounts_only; created_by oliver.

jess (CS): customer wants the credit to avoid churn.

oliver (AE): uploaded my email thread to the ticket. sorry team.

hana (Finance): nate (RevenueOps) signoff needed. Nate, can you approve $32,450 credit?

diego (Billing): creating manual adjustment ADJ-2026-4155 and credit memo CM-2026-195. Will tag GL 4-2100 and hold in AR pending final AE evidence.

hana (Finance): approved conditionally by Nate (via DM). Proceed with CM and mark FIN-5077 for root-cause. Notify customer once posted.

jess (CS): customer notified: "we've posted a one-time credit while we fix the voucher config. we'll follow up with process changes." They replied thanks.

billing-bot: adjustment ADJ-2026-4155 recorded; audit ref CM-2026-195. FIN-5077 created and assigned to billing-platform.

hana (Finance): closing loop: release AR hold after AE evidence confirmed. Thanks all.
